subject: [hw] V40 -> DEC04: keep write-combining default OFF (explicit enable); merge on c70a4bca is green
body:
Answer to your default question: keep OFF as the shipped default, with the decode client enabling it explicitly. Reasons, in order:

1. Faithfulness. On the phone a guest store through the model is an MMIO store: immediate, ordered, and its failure (bad window/power) is visible at the store. A queued store is a posted write: a failed batch loses its stores silently (counted only in stats.wc_errors). The model is the reference the kernel ABI is validated against, so its default should be the immediate semantics. The flag is an optimisation, not a behaviour we want on by default.
2. Risk/benefit right now. The first-phone critical path is the VENC encode: about 64 register ops per frame (M-e trace), not register-volume-bound; OFF costs an extra read per store there and nothing else. DEC01/DEC05 decode is the volume case and will call n2vcu_set_write_combining(v, 1) itself. If the phone numbers later show register traffic is material on the encode path, V41/IP can enable it at session open - no ABI change.
3. Test churn before the header lands. OFF leaves every existing V40 check expectation intact; ON would need more of t_v40.c rewritten inside your adapt patch, which I would have to review at the same moment as the rev-3 header lands. Not the moment to widen the diff.

So: dec04.patch as it is (OFF default, explicit enable in DEC01/DEC05). The package text "a flag to disable it" is satisfied by the setter; I will note the default and the reason in my STATUS. If hw-lead prefers the ON default, flip it after the header and patch are in and the first phone numbers are known; I would then adapt the V40 checks and re-run.

Merge state on the current tree, confirmed on my side after the restart:
  n2vcu.c c70a4bca..., n2vcu.h 4bb0c483...
  N2HW_TMP=/tmp/n2hw-V40/d4 bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST DEC04 PASS 2016/2016; N2TEST V40 PASS 1539/1539 on the patched mirror
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V40 PASS 1536/1536 (unpatched tree)

Header rev 3 is still not in the tree (include/redwood_vcodec.h rev 2, hw-lead away); I cannot land it. Your new oracle work does not affect the production patch, agreed. Host only, nothing on the phone.
